body.name: Two-stratum four-treatment threshold example
body.construction: Use the fully specified instance \(\mathfrak E\). Before edge \(13\) is added, the \(x_1\) effective operator has the null vector with node rows \(h_1=(44,-20)\), \(h_2=(-16,16)\), and \(h_3=(-7,9)\), while \(h=0\) at \(x_2\). The five-atom outcome support has the explicit right inverse \(\Gamma(d)(0000)=-\sum_{a=0}^3d_a\), \(\Gamma(d)(1000)=d_0\), \(\Gamma(d)(0100)=d_1\), \(\Gamma(d)(0010)=d_2\), and \(\Gamma(d)(0001)=d_3\). Add edge \(13\) with its sixth attainable row to obtain the two tree decomposition \(\{01,12,23\}\cup\{02,03,13\}\).
